definitions.present: ground-truth objects with a visible 2D box and a visible fraction above the presence threshold
definitions.clearly_visible: present objects with visible fraction >= 0.3 and truncated fraction <= 0.3 (question referent thresholds)
definitions.paired: the pipeline's 2D association (Hungarian on 2D IoU >= 0.3, class-agnostic) pairs a labelled box (a detection with a box from the source) with the object; views re-associated with rematch_view
definitions.miss_causes: no_detection: no detection overlaps the visible box at the threshold; unboxed: only detections without a box from the source do; assignment: a boxed detection does, but was assigned to another object
definitions.range: camera centre to ground-truth box centre (m), bins of scripts/compare_association.py
definitions.bootstrap: scene-cluster bootstrap 95% percentile interval (whole scenes resampled), overall rows only
definitions.n_views: views with at least one object of the group
definitions.coverage: questions with an automatic answer / questions; every unanswered question has a missed referent
definitions.count_silent_miss: a wrong automatic count with at least one missed instance of the class
definitions.closest_open_world: with the reference and >= --min-candidates candidates paired, answer among the paired candidates (a labeller offers only what it found)
definitions.closest_silent_miss: a wrong open-world closest-instance answer whose true answer object was missed
definitions.flag_hit: a flag overlapping (2D IoU >= 0.3) the visible box of a present object the flagged labeller missed
definitions.flag_recall: misses some flag hits / misses in the covered views
definitions.unannotated_flag: a flag overlapping no present ground-truth object at the threshold; NOT a false flag: ARKitScenes annotates 17 furniture classes and CuTR is class-agnostic, so many point at real objects without a box. n_unannotated_near counts those overlapping a present object at IoU >= near_iou (likely mislocalised)
definitions.flaggable: projected flags: a miss whose ground-truth box passes the same projection test
definitions.cross_labeller: witness boxes (CuTR) with no labelled box at 2D IoU >= 0.3, both directions; the reverse direction's labeller is the predictions set's raw boxes (source 'boxes')
definitions.cross_frame: the labeller's boxes from other views of the same static video, clustered in 3D, projected; kept if mostly inside the image and unoccluded by the view's iPad LiDAR depth (never laser)
definitions.cross_camera: the labeller's boxes from other cameras at the same frame index, projected; geometry only (no depth independent of the reference is stored)
